description: Defines the MojoAudioDecoder class, a media audio decoder that proxies to a mojom::AudioDecoder, including its interface, member variables, and method declarations.

classes.name: MojoAudioDecoder
classes.description: A final class implementing AudioDecoder and mojom::AudioDecoderClient, acting as a proxy to a mojom::AudioDecoder.

methods.name: MojoAudioDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MojoAudioDecoder with a task runner, media log, and remote decoder.

methods.name: IsPlatformDecoder
methods.description: Returns whether the decoder is a platform decoder.

methods.name: SupportsDecryption
methods.description: Returns whether the decoder supports decryption.

methods.name: GetDecoderType
methods.description: Returns the type of the decoder.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration, CDM context, and callbacks.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a given buffer with a callback.

methods.name: NeedsBitstreamConversion
methods.description: Indicates if bitstream conversion is needed.

methods.name: OnBufferDecoded
methods.description: Handles a decoded buffer received from the remote decoder.

methods.name: OnWaiting
methods.description: Handles waiting reasons from the remote decoder.

methods.name: set_writer_capacity_for_testing
methods.description: Sets the buffer writer capacity for testing purposes.
